rust_summary: reading a server player's smoothed keep-alive latency (`native_player_latency_ms`).
doc_summary: Read a connected, ready player's smoothed server keep-alive latency with `native_player_latency_ms(uuid)`. It returns none outside a server tick, when the player is unavailable, or after 512 calls per mod in a tick. Bundles need fragment @API:player_latency@.
